messages:
olivia: Quick q — planning to enable the pii_audit_toggle for a small canary tomorrow AM. Need to confirm gating matrix, KMS/HSM path priorities, and retention guardrails before I flip. Proposed plan below, PTAL.

olivia: ```json
{
  "flag": "pii_audit_toggle",
  "state": "on",
  "scope": ["eng-canary-1", "infra-canary"],
  "kms_priority": ["customer-kms", "redwood-hsm"],
  "retention_days": 30,
  "telemetry_event": "pii.audit.toggle"
}
```

sam: Quick question — telemetry_event name should match observability schema. Can we use `pii.audit.toggle` (dot-delimited) instead of underscore?

maria: Agreed on telemetry name. Also: enforce KMS priority only for Dedicated customers. For Hosted use redwood-kms with HSM fallback. Add runtime guard to strip raw payloads unless `audit_mode=true`.

jun: One more: disable KV prefix caching on any routes that will include PII audit blobs. We can't risk cache leaks; prefer cache=false for those endpoints.

kate: I'll take CR for the feature-flag RFC. Please add canary metrics: `pii.audit.error_rate` and `pii.audit.success_count`. Alert if error_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

olivia: Updated plan per comments — telemetry is `pii.audit.toggle`, KMS priority split, cache disabled on routes, retention set to 30d. Rollout plan:

olivia: ```
1) Create LD flag `pii_audit_toggle` targeting eng-canary-1 + infra-canary
2) Enable with 0% traffic default, 100% for the two canaries
3) Smoke test in canaries (10m)
4) Monitor `pii.audit.error_rate` and logs for 30m
5) If stable, increment to 5% for 1h, then 25% for 3h, then 100% over 24h
6) If error_rate > 0.5% or any PII leak detected -> rollback to 0% immediately
```

deploy-bot: Flag `pii_audit_toggle` created by olivia. https://flags.internal/LD/12345

sam: I'm oncall during the 09:30 PST rollout window — will watch dashboards.

maria: LGTM :thumbsup:

jun: I'll double-check KMS IAM perms and key rotation hooks before flip.

kate: CR submitted — see PR #4521. Minor comments left.

olivia: Thanks all; will schedule for 09:30 PST tomorrow and post a reminder in #eng-oncall. Ping if anything else before then.
